The objects function: bg = mostcolor(grid) if without_bg. For each unvisited loc not occupied, val = grid[loc]. if val == bg: continue. obj = {(val, loc)}. cands = {loc}. While cands: neighborhood = set(); for cand in cands: v = grid[cand]; if (val==v) if univalued else (v != bg): obj.add((v,cand)); occupied.add(cand); neighborhood |= neighbors-of-cand within bounds. cands = neighborhood - occupied.

Hmm, actually it adds cand to obj and occupied but the cands expansion includes all neighbors. Wait the neighborhood is built from cand regardless. Then cands = neighborhood - occupied. Next iteration checks color of each cand.
